更新记录What’s New

每一次版本更新都写在这里，最新的一版排在最上面。 Every release and improvement, newest first.

0.1.7 最新Latest 2026-11-27
  • Windows
    Windows 正式版同步发布：同步至 0.1.7 并补齐自定义翻页音效（6 种拟真声学预设、音量调节、麦克风录音与音频导入裁剪）、阅读页与设置页 Fluent 2 界面打磨、品牌图标统一及 150+ 项英文界面补全；修复书架双击打开竞态与批量操作栏弹出导致的布局跳动。 Windows 0.1.7 release & parity: shipped Windows alongside Apple and Android with custom page-turn sounds (6 acoustic presets, volume slider, mic recording & audio import with auto-trim/normalization), Fluent 2 polish across Settings, Reader, Library, Audiobook, and Podcast views, 150+ completed English UI translations, and fixes for shelf double-click races and batch-bar layout shifts.
  • 全平台All
    书架标签记忆：全端（iOS / Android / macOS / Windows）记住上次停留的书架分类标签（书、播客、音频、收藏集等），重启后自动恢复；修复 Android 从笔记、发现或个人页切回首页时自动重置回「书」的问题，并在对应分类隐藏或删除时自动回退。 Shelf tab persistence: remembered the last active Shelf sub-tab (Books, Podcasts, Audio, Collections, etc.) across app restarts on iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows, fixed Android resetting back to Books when returning from other bottom tabs, and automatically fall back when a sub-tab is promoted, hidden, or deleted.
  • 全平台All
    播客往期拉取与排序：移除 RSS 仅保留近 14 天节目的硬限制，订阅与刷新改为拉取最近 20 期并按发布时间正确倒序展示；进入单个节目视图可查看全部已拉取单集，并新增按需「加载更多往期」分批拉取更早的历史节目。 Podcast archive fetching & sorting: removed the 14-day hard cutoff on RSS ingestion so subscribing and refreshing keep up to 20 recent episodes sorted newest-first, showed all fetched episodes when filtering by a single show across all platforms, and added on-demand “Load older episodes” to fetch earlier back-catalog batches.
  • Android
    Android 稳定性与系统语音修复：拆分自定义翻页音效弹窗组件并新增 Release 包 DEX 寄存器上限校验，避免 R8 压缩触发启动 VerifyError；优化 Android 切换系统默认 TTS 引擎后的热检测，并在返回页面时自动刷新音色列表。 Android release stability & system TTS refresh: split the custom page-turn sound sheet and added a release DEX register check (< 256 registers) to guard against R8 VerifyError crashes, and refreshed Android system TTS voices on resume when switching OEM default TTS engines.
0.1.6 2026-11-27
  • 全平台All
    广播剧旁白与语音修复：修复开启广播剧模式后旁白被切回系统自带声音、设置页与阅读页偏好键（zh/zh-Hans）不同步以及旧预合成片段未随旁白刷新的全端问题；扩展 Kokoro 离线音色库至 32 款并彻底清除 INT8 底噪与高频蜂鸣，优化 Android 系统 TTS 默认直连与语言匹配。 Audio drama narrator & voice fixes: fixed turning on Audio Drama mode unexpectedly switching the narrator back to a system voice, unified canonical voice preference keys across Settings and Reader, and refreshed Live casting plans before reading stale cached clips across Apple, Android, and Windows; expanded curated Kokoro offline voices to 32 while eliminating INT8 buzz, and improved Android OEM system TTS detection and locale matching.
  • 全平台All
    翻页音效与阅读细节：新增自定义翻页音效、音量调节与触觉反馈；改进广播剧对话气泡拆分与展示；统一 macOS 阅读器翻译浮窗样式，并把全端「播客」图标统一为收音机图标。 Custom page-turn sounds & reader polish: added custom page-turn audio, volume control, and haptics; refined dialogue speech bubbles and spans; aligned the macOS reader translation popover with Windows; and unified the Podcast icon across iOS, Android, and Windows to match macOS’s radio icon.
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    自定义底部导航与设置搜索：iPhone / Android 新增可视化拖拽定制底部导航（支持排序、替换、折叠进书架与隐藏）及 Android 液态玻璃底栏；macOS 设置页新增全局即时搜索（支持中文、拼音首字母与英文关键词）。 Customizable bottom navigation & macOS Settings search: added direct-manipulation bottom tab customization on iOS and Android (reorder, replace, fold into Shelf, hide) plus Android Liquid Glass tab bar support, and added instant global search (Chinese, pinyin initials, and English keywords) to macOS Settings.
0.1.5 2026-11-26
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    本机声音克隆修复：修复 Android 端在切换默认离线旁白后缺失声音克隆模型（ZipVoice）下载入口、导致录完音仍报「合成失败」的问题；在克隆、详情、选声、朗读面板与离线语音设置中全面补齐自动准备与手动下载进度条，Apple 端同步补齐引导。 Local voice cloning fix: restored the missing on-device voice cloning model (ZipVoice) download triggers and inline progress bars across Android and Apple cloning, detail, voice picker, listen, and settings screens, replacing misleading synthesis failure errors with clear download status.
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    绝不擅自换声：全端移除广播剧隐藏替换云端旁白的逻辑，取消设备发烫时自动切回系统机械音（改为放慢后台预合成并轻提示）；广播剧、角色分声、跨章语言不兼容或云端克隆异常时均停下明确告知，由用户决定重试或更换声音；修复 Apple 端跨章语言标签与后台同步导致的静默切声。 Never switch voices without consent: removed hidden cloud-narrator substitution in drama mode across all platforms, stopped thermal throttling from auto-switching to system voices (throttling background pre-rendering with a gentle notice instead), and ensured drama, character, saved-voice, and ElevenLabs errors pause with clear choices rather than silently falling back; fixed Apple canonical language cache keys and mid-playback cache clears.
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    TXT 识别与翻页体验：改进网文 TXT 行内书名/作者解析并过滤下载站广告，增强卷标、紧凑标题与纯数字章节目录识别；修复 Android 分页阅读点击翻页与跨章预加载衔接稳定性。 TXT parsing & tap page turns: improved inline title/author parsing while filtering promo lines, broadened TXT chapter heading detection, and fixed Android paginated WebView tap page turns and cross-section settling.
  • Mac · iOS
    Apple 书伴优化：在不支持 Apple 智能的设备上自动隐藏该项并优先选用已配置的第三方模型或展示引导配置卡片。 Apple Companion polish: hid unsupported Apple Intelligence options on older devices and added a clear setup card when no third-party model provider is configured.
0.1.4 2026-11-26
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    阅读快捷控制与护眼柔光：重构 Mac、iPhone / iPad 与 Android 的阅读页「更多」菜单，新增独立亮度调节与跟随系统开关、保留各自纸色偏好的「日间 / 夜间」一键切换，以及可叠加于任意纸色之上的独立「护眼柔光」暖色滤蓝光模式。 Redesigned reader More controls & Eye-Care Warmth: rebuilt the reader ··· menu across Mac, iPhone / iPad, and Android with an independent brightness bar + Follow System switch, a Day/Night polarity toggle that preserves your Aa paper choices, and an independent warm blue-light Eye-Care filter.
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    三态译文与 AI 书伴升级：译文支持「原文 / 双语对照 / 仅译文」三态即时切换（macOS 顶栏 译 升级为带图标三态菜单，并精简 Aa 与顶栏按钮）；AI 书伴新增快捷指令、多选保存与段落翻译。 Three-mode translation & Book Companion upgrades: added Original / Bilingual / Translation-Only instant switching (with an icon-equipped toolbar menu on macOS and streamlined Aa / toolbar controls), plus Book Companion slash commands, multi-select save, and AI paragraph translation.
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    翻页动效、书架样式与外观增强：全端新增「滑动 / 覆盖阴影 / 无动画」三档翻页动效及可选轻翻页音效；手机端书架新增「书脊排列」与「浅木层板」样式；Android 端补齐液态玻璃质感开关；Apple 端新增 6 款液态玻璃应用图标及年度阅读热力图。 Page turns, shelf styles & visual polish: added Slide / Cover (with edge shadow) / None page turns and optional turn sound; added Spine view and Light Wood Ledge shelf styles on mobile; brought Liquid Glass controls to Android; and added six Liquid Glass app icons and an annual reading heatmap on Apple.
  • Mac · iOS · Android
    同步与稳定性修复：新增 WebDAV 同步检查视图，优化离线语音就绪提示球与选词浮卡定位，并修复多项跨端朗读、字体、反馈与多语言问题。 Sync & stability fixes: added a WebDAV sync inspector, refined the offline-voice ready orb and floating selection cards, and resolved cross-platform voice, font, feedback, and localization issues.
0.1.3 2026-11-24
  • 全平台All
    上下滚动拉动切章：在 Mac、iPhone / iPad 与 Android 的上下滚动阅读模式下，滑到章首或章末继续上拉/下拉即可顺滑切换上一章或下一章（支持触觉反馈、纸面拉动提示，以及读至全书末尾时的读完提示），并在滚动模式下统一纵向翻章动效。 Pull-to-cross chapters in scrolled mode: on Mac, iPhone / iPad, and Android, pull past the top or bottom of a chapter in vertical scrolled mode to cross smoothly into the previous or next chapter (with haptic arming, edge pull cues, vertical chapter transitions, and a finished-book prompt at book end).
  • 全平台All
    国内更新与下载加速：新增国内高速更新与下载线路，中文环境下检查更新与下载安装包将优先走国内直链，网络不可用时自动回退至 GitHub。 Faster China download & update mirror: added a direct China mirror for release downloads and in-app updates, prioritized automatically for mainland Chinese locales with seamless fallback to GitHub.
  • Mac · iOS
    性能优化：修复 macOS 设置页从「外观」切到「通用」时的卡顿，将语音合成、云同步与监听文件夹扫描等耗时操作移出主线程，并优化阅读目录缓存、纸张纹理渲染、PDF 内存回收与播客阅读页滚动流畅度。 Performance improvements: fixed stutter when switching from Appearance to General in macOS Settings, moved speech synthesis, sync, and watched-folder scanning off the main thread, and optimized reader TOC caching, paper textures, PDF memory cleanup, and podcast reading scroll smoothness.
  • 全平台All
    版本号与更新状态修复：区分版本版次与显示版本号，升级到新版本后自动清理旧的更新检查残留状态。 Update state & version display fixes: separated release edition ordinal from the display version string and cleared stale update-check state after upgrading.
0.1.2 2026-11-24
  • Android
    打开书籍闪退修复：修复 0.1.1 版本在 Android 上点击书籍（EPUB、TXT、MOBI 等，包含旧版本已导入的书籍）进入阅读时直接闪退回桌面的问题。 Book-opening crash fix: fixed a 0.1.1 regression on Android that crashed back to the home screen when opening books (EPUB, TXT, MOBI, etc., including books imported in earlier versions).
  • 全平台All
    部分 MOBI 导入与格式识别修复：修复含长章节、旧版编码或特殊文件头的 MOBI 书籍导入失败的问题，并补齐 Android 打开 MOBI 文件的格式识别。 MOBI import fixes: fixed import failures on MOBI files with long chapters, legacy encodings, or older header layouts, and added Android file-type associations for opening MOBI files.
  • 全平台All
    部分 EPUB 误报 DRM 修复：修复正文实际未加密、仅残留加密标记或仅锁定内嵌字体的 EPUB 书籍导入时被误判为「有 DRM 无法导入」的问题。 False EPUB DRM warnings: fixed unencrypted EPUBs (such as files with leftover DRM metadata or encrypted/obfuscated embedded fonts) being wrongly rejected as DRM-protected on import.
  • 全平台All
    跨端稳定性修复：同步修复多项跨端朗读与语音下载、Wi‑Fi 传书、自定义字体、应用内更新、旧版苹果系统兼容以及界面与多语言细节问题。 Other stability fixes: improved cross-platform read-aloud and voice downloads, Wi‑Fi transfer, custom fonts, in-app update installation, macOS 14 / iOS 17 compatibility, and UI/localization details.
0.1.1 2026-11-24
  • Mac · iOS
    Intel Mac 与旧系统支持：新增 Mac Intel（x86_64）安装包与独立更新通道；Mac 最低系统要求下调至 macOS 14（Sonoma），iPhone / iPad 下调至 iOS / iPadOS 17。 Intel Mac & broader Apple OS support: added Intel (x86_64) Mac builds with a dedicated update feed, and lowered minimum requirements to macOS 14 (Sonoma) and iOS / iPadOS 17.
  • 全平台All
    朗读声音增强：Mac、iPhone / iPad 与 Android 新增免 Key 的 Microsoft Edge 在线神经朗读来源（内置 22 个精选音色）；修复 Android 正式包下本机离线语音（Kokoro / 声音卡）闪退以及部分免费在线语音不可用的问题。 Read-aloud voices: added a keyless Microsoft Edge neural TTS provider (22 curated voices) on Mac, iOS and Android; fixed release-build crashes for offline ONNX voices (Kokoro / voice cards) on Android and broken free online routes.
  • 全平台All
    EPUB 字体与外观跟随：修复部分 EPUB 书籍因内联字体规则或错误语言标记导致切换字体不生效、以及含空格/中文名导入字体无法加载的问题；阅读纸张支持随应用深浅外观自动切换。 Reliable EPUB fonts & appearance matching: fixed publisher inline font rules and mislabeled language tags overriding reader font choices, fixed URL-encoded custom font filenames, and added automatic reading-paper matching with app light/dark appearance.
  • 全平台All
    稳定性与交互修复：修复 Mac 下载本机离线语音模型时的界面卡顿，修复各端听读切句与睡眠定时音量恢复、系统声音试听、有声书播放、OPDS / WebDAV 远程书库、应用内更新安装以及多处英文界面截断问题。 Stability & UI fixes: eliminated macOS UI freezes during offline voice downloads, and fixed playback/sleep-timer volume recovery, system voice previews, audiobook streaming, OPDS / WebDAV remote libraries, in-app update handling, and English UI truncation across platforms.
0.1.0 · 首个公开版0.1.0 · First Public Release 2026-11-23
  • 全平台All
    安静的本地书房：支持在 Mac、Android、iPhone 与 iPad 上打开 EPUB、PDF、TXT 与无加密 MOBI / AZW3 电子书（Windows 端开发中），内置多套纸张与单双栏排版；支持 Wi‑Fi 无线传书与连接家庭书库。 A quiet local library: read EPUB, PDF, TXT, and DRM-free MOBI / AZW3 across Mac, Android, iPhone, and iPad (Windows in progress) with custom papers, local Wi‑Fi transfer, and home library connections.
  • 全平台All
    逐句听读：点任意一句开始朗读，墨线跟着声音逐句推进、自动翻页；支持本机离线声音、系统声音与自接云端人声，锁屏和耳机线控都能切句暂停。 Read aloud: tap any sentence to hear it aloud as the ink line moves forward and pages turn automatically—supporting local offline voices, system voices, cloud voices, and lock-screen controls.
  • 全平台All
    播客与有声空间：订阅播客节目或导入有声书，排成清爽可查词、可划原声切片的阅读页（有声书录音对齐与分角色朗读亦在持续打磨中）。 Podcasts & audiobooks: subscribe to podcasts or import audiobooks into readable, searchable pages where you can look up words and save audio clips (forced alignment and character voices continue in active polish).
  • 全平台All
    外文精读与防剧透「书伴」：外文书支持离线查词、行间难词简注、双击整句翻译与生词本；防剧透「书伴」默认只在你已读过的部分里回答，每句话都能直接点回原文。 Foreign reading & spoiler-free Companion: offline dictionary, subtle interlinear glosses, sentence translation, and word list—paired with a spoiler-free Reading Companion grounded strictly in what you’ve already read.
  • 全平台All
    笔记、回顾与导出：多样式划线、想法、今日回顾、书摘卡片与纸书记录；随时一键导出到 Markdown、Obsidian、Notion、flomo、新枝、Anki、带划线的 EPUB 与阅读记录表。 Notes, review & export: multi-style highlights, thoughts, Daily Review, quote cards, and paper-book logging—exportable to Markdown, Obsidian, Notion, flomo, Xinzhi, Anki, highlighted EPUB, and CSV.
  • 全平台All
    同步与反馈：经由你自己的 iCloud 云盘或私人网盘同步阅读进度、划线与播客（遇到冲突并排自选），支持整库一键备份，以及应用内直接反馈问题。 Sync & feedback: sync progress, notes, and podcasts via your own iCloud Drive or personal cloud storage with side-by-side conflict resolution, full-library backups, and in-app feedback.
